spec_match.rationale: Attempts the real end-to-end contract markers exist for: construct Profiler, run a genuinely mixed workload (script, forced style/layout, allocation storm), stop(), then analyse the actual trace — sample/stack coverage and the per-marker histogram including the missing-marker=idle and marker+stack categories.

interactive.rationale: The run button executes the real construction and workload; the result panel is built entirely from the returned trace or the actual thrown error.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card promises a real attempted run with histogram or an honest blocked panel; both branches exist and were exercised.

edge_cases.rationale: Separate gates for missing global vs policy block, a samplebufferfull listener, a marker-less-trace explanation that names the flag/OT and isolation state instead of claiming success, and an explicit no-simulation statement in the blocked panel.

references.rationale: Links both sibling concepts and the Chrome sample repo; the feature index carries the ChromeStatus link.

conformance.rationale: The suite proves the success path is real on this site (policy-enabled iframe assertion passes with a real trace) and records the marker contracts blocked with precise prerequisites — matching this page's honest branches.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP driver run 2026-08-16 (f3-lab.png): the attempt threw DOMException (NotAllowedError) 'Failed to construct Profiler: JS profiling is disabled by Document Policy.' and the blocked panel named the Document-Policy gate with the v147 link; zero console errors, no failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts trace-lab-real-run on real traces and trace-lab-blocked-branch for the gated path — the blocked branch is never recorded as success.

design_system.rationale: Variables only; blocked panel uses an amber left border on stone, trace panel emerald; histogram bars are accent-blue on paper cells.

accessibility.rationale: Result host is role=status aria-live polite; histogram is a semantic table with scoped headers; the run button disables while running with visible focus styling.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; stats use an auto-fit grid and long log lines wrap.

guidanceConsulted.query: async long-running action result announcement and disabled state
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce results in a live region, disable the trigger during the run, and present quantitative results in semantic tables.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: result-host is aria-live polite role=status; the button disables during the ~1s run; histogram and stats are table/dl-style semantic markup.

guidanceConsulted.query: running a heavy demo workload without wrecking interaction responsiveness
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Keep intentionally heavy work bounded and user-triggered; never run it on page load.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The ~1s workload only runs on click, is bounded (18×fib(24), 300 layout cycles, 1M short-lived allocations), and its phases are logged with real timings.

summary: The practical run: real constructor, real mixed workload, real analysis — currently landing in the honest blocked branch on this header-less route with Chrome's exact NotAllowedError surfaced and zero fabricated output. Ready to light up end-to-end once the server TODO is wired.
